sentences.text: Madonna Louise Ciccone -LRB- -LSB- tʃɪˈkoʊni -RSB- born August 16 , 1958 -RRB- is an American singer , songwriter , actress , and businesswoman .
She achieved popularity by pushing the boundaries of lyrical content in mainstream popular music and imagery in her music videos , which became a fixture on MTV .	MTV	MTV
Madonna is known for reinventing both her music and image , and for maintaining her autonomy within the recording industry .
Music critics have acclaimed her musical productions , which have generated some controversy .	Music critics	Music criticism	Music	Music (Madonna song)

Referred to as the `` Queen of Pop '' , Madonna is often cited as an influence by other artists .	Pop	pop music	Queen of Pop	Honorific nicknames in popular music	other artists	List of artists influenced by Madonna
